analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 44.3 exiting oversold and continuing neutral range consolidation. MACD histogram improved from -0.2817 to 0.1748 but remains negative. Five consecutive positive candles forming a Higher Low pattern above the 5-day low ($269.88), but facing resistance at SMA20 ($277.75) and the Bollinger Band middle line. Low volume reduces conviction for trend change. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for the third consecutive session.
